mintAuthority.summary: WTGXX has six independently mint-capable native EVM deployments on Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, and Plume. Each local token gates mint/burn through REGISTRAR_ROLE held by 0x726D3b3e18e301719b383FdE4F99A5d31B9438e5, while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by 0x6257759edD99f677052727f7Ef3a055029DFA58a can administer roles and upgrade the local custom beacon. The Stellar issuer account is excluded from scoreable WTGXX scope pending resolution of Horizon's WTGX-versus-WTGXX asset-code mismatch.

review.evidence: At the 2026-08-16 UTC observations, the six authored EVM deployments had live code and returned the WTGXX role and supply calls. REGISTRAR_ROLE = keccak256('REGISTRAR_ROLE') gates local mint(address,uint256) and burn(address,uint256), and 0x726d3b3e18e301719b383fde4f99a5d31b9438e5 held it on Arbitrum block 495304232, Avalanche block 92984819, Base block 50067802, Ethereum block 25771084, Optimism block 155663088, and Plume block 87697435. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was held by 0x6257759edd99f677052727f7ef3a055029dfa58a on all six deployments; the verified implementation gates role administration and upgradeBeaconToAndCall(address,bytes) with that role. Current custom beacon and implementation reads were Arbitrum 0x9a289c9976215664c265a35ecb2fa733295369e7 -> 0x6e46c98c4805b7cad59d557e1c47af535f1706b1, Avalanche 0xc2f490d5ab8e918686ad4bb795b1bd7f60dbf7b1 -> 0xc2a8ca84bc363605c36757f9409b214b6ee710c9, Base 0x1fecf3d9d4fee7f2c02917a66028a48c6706c179 -> 0xc2f490d5ab8e918686ad4bb795b1bd7f60dbf7b1, Ethereum 0xf89aa0ae2b6c47c0eaefb49abcc266a44a1b61cb -> 0xc2a8ca84bc363605c36757f9409b214b6ee710c9, Optimism 0xc2f490d5ab8e918686ad4bb795b1bd7f60dbf7b1 -> 0xc2a8ca84bc363605c36757f9409b214b6ee710c9, and Plume 0x507d898226e6a3e5eb8dbecae0b9e8fd51337656 -> 0x6e46c98c4805b7cad59d557e1c47af535f1706b1. No economic cap or cross-chain conservation invariant was established, so the canonical posture remains unbounded with periodic off-chain reconciliation and prudential SEC oversight. Horizon verifies the authored Stellar issuer account and a live WTGX asset, but WTGXX returns no asset record; the Stellar row is therefore excluded from this scoreable WTGXX native scope pending issuer-side identity confirmation.
